title: Incremental load profiles for PR gating and CI drift alerts
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: Add an incremental, multi-profile load-testing harness in CI to detect token/sec regressions and p95 latency drift early (PR quick checks) and nightly (baseline comparisons). This ticket implements synthetic load profiles (cold-start, steady-state, burst), a configurable statistical detector (CUSUM + bootstrap p95 CI), and PR gating rules that surface soft warnings for maintainers and hard failures for large regressions. The harness will be lightweight for PRs (sampled microbenchmarks against a pinned model artifact) and full-fidelity for nightly baselines (longer runs, wider sequence lengths). Store metrics in the performance datastore with per-model, per-commit baselines and provenance metadata.
acceptance_criteria: PR quick-run executes in < 8 minutes with sampled microbenchmarks and returns tokens/sec and p95 summaries
Nightly baseline job runs full profiles and updates per-model baselines in the performance datastore
Statistical detector raises alert if p95 increases by >10% with 95% confidence (configurable) and records a regression event
PRs with detected regressions produce an annotated GitHub check with links to detailed run traces, diffs against baseline, and suggested revert/bisect instructions
Grafana dashboard shows time series for tokens/sec and p95 per model and highlights regression windows from detector events
implementation_notes: Create lightweight harness runner binary (perf-harness) that accepts YAML profile (sequence_lengths, batch_sizes, concurrency, duration)
Integrate existing trace-friendly runner used by ENG-12853 to capture op-by-op latency samples for p95 bootstrap
Use CUSUM for change detection on tokens/sec and bootstrap CI for p95; keep thresholds configurable per project/model
Persist results to perf-store under key: model@commit:profile:run_id with metadata (docker image, kernel tags, quantization flags)
Expose a REST endpoint for CI to fetch last known baseline and for the detector to compute deltas
Implement GitHub check reporter that posts summary, status, and links to the full run trace and comparison JSON
test_plan: Unit tests for harness parsing, synthetic generator, and metric aggregation
Integration test: run PR quick-run workflow against a golden model artifact and assert runtime < 8m and metrics recorded
E2E staging job: nightly full-profile run seeded with synthetic regression to validate detector fires and GitHub check is created
Load test of perf-store ingestion at expected nightly scale (500 runs/day)
Manual review: product/infra review the Grafana dashboard and the GitHub check UX with two sample regressions
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (canary): enable PR quick-run for runtime team only; monitor false positive rate for two weeks
Phase 2: enable for all eng teams with soft warnings surfaced in checks; add docs and troubleshooting playbook
Phase 3: promote nightly baseline as source-of-truth and enable hard failures for quantitatively large regressions after cross-team signoff
If detector shows >5% false positives in canary, switch to log-only mode and iterate on thresholds and detector parameters
